title: 국립공원공단법 시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:29489:20190115:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 29489, January 15, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 17, 2019.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Forest Protection Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (1) 4, "Korea National Park Management Corporation" shall be replaced with "Korea National Park Service."

(2) The Enforcement Decree of the Natural Parks Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 5 (3) 2 and Article 27-4 (4) 2, respectively, "Korea National Park Management Corporation" shall be replaced with "Korea National Park Service."

(3) The Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on the Management of Disasters and Safety shall be partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 32 of Attached Table 1-2 shall read as follows:

32. Korea National Park Service

(4) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Aggravated Punishment, etc. of Specific Crimes shall be partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 13 of Article 2 shall read as follows:

13. Korea National Park Service

(5) The Enforcement Decree of the Aviation Safety Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 3, "Korea National Park Management Corporation under the Korea National Park Management Corporation Act" shall be replaced with "Korea National Park Service under the Korea National Park Service Act."
